_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you.
The Lord make his face to shine upon us.
On the eighth day they gave him a name.
Jesus: the Lord saves.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
We are no longer slaves, but children.
Come, let us worship in the name of Jesus.
Glory to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you — the old blessing that lays God's own name on his people like light.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
On the eighth day the child is given his name, the name the angel spoke: Jesus, because he will save.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
Because of this child you are no longer a slave but a daughter, a son, with the Spirit in you crying Abba, Father.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
So lift up that name above every name, here in this house and to the ends of the earth.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Glory to God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you and shine on you.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
On the eighth day they named the child Jesus.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
No longer slaves, we cry out, Abba, Father.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.

The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Glory to God!
